name: fourdayweek-mcp
description: 4dayweek.io (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: 'A free, public, no-auth JSON API for every live job on 4dayweek.io': q = full-text search, page ('Default 1'), limit ('Default 25. Max 100'), country 'matches office or remote-allowed country' — a country name, so location is sent as country and the alpha-2 country argument is not. id is the slug (use it with get_posting); salary_min/salary_max are in cents of salary_currency per salary_period ('8000000 = $80,000 USD'); location is the primary location's country (locations[] and work_arrangement in raw). Limits: '60 requests per minute per IP across both /api/v1 and /api/v2' (429 + Retry-After), responses cached 60 s. 'Please link back to https://4dayweek.io.'

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /api/v2/jobs/{slug} 'Returns a single V2JobDTO (same shape as an item from the list) or 404'.
